permalink: /llms-full.txt

{% comment %}
  The long companion of llms.txt: the CV and the text of every post in one plain-text file, built from the same
  data as the pages (assets/json/resume_LANG.json and the posts), once per language.
{% endcomment %}
{%- assign s = site.data[site.active_lang].strings -%}
{%- assign resume_key = site.active_lang | prepend: 'resume_' -%}
{%- assign resume = site.data[resume_key] -%}
{%- capture lang_root %}{{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}{% unless site.active_lang == site.default_lang %}/{{ site.active_lang }}{% endunless %}{% endcapture -%}
# {{ s.name.first }} {{ s.name.middle }} {{ s.name.last }}

> {{ s.site_description }}

{{ lang_root }}/ · {{ lang_root }}/cv/ · {{ lang_root }}/blog/ · {{ lang_root }}/llms.txt

## {{ s.cv.summary }}

{{ resume.basics.label }}. {{ resume.basics.summary }}

## {{ s.cv.work }}
{% for job in resume.work %}
### {{ job.position }}, {{ job.name }} ({{ job.startDate | date: '%Y-%m' }} – {% if job.endDate %}{{ job.endDate | date: '%Y-%m' }}{% else %}{{ s.cv.present }}{% endif %})

{{ job.summary }}
{% for item in job.highlights %}
- {{ item }}
{%- endfor %}
{% endfor %}
## {{ s.cv.projects }}
{% for project in resume.projects %}
### {{ project.name }}{% if project.startDate %} ({{ project.startDate | date: '%Y-%m' }} – {% if project.endDate %}{{ project.endDate | date: '%Y-%m' }}{% else %}{{ s.cv.present }}{% endif %}){% endif %}

{{ project.summary }}
{% for item in project.highlights %}
- {{ item }}
{%- endfor %}
{% endfor %}
## {{ s.cv.skills }}
{% for skill in resume.skills %}
- {{ skill.name }}: {{ skill.keywords | join: ', ' }}
{%- endfor %}

## {{ s.cv.certificates }}
{% for certificate in resume.certificates %}
- {{ certificate.name }} ({{ certificate.issuer }})
{%- endfor %}

## {{ s.cv.education }}
{% for school in resume.education %}
- {{ school.institution }}: {{ school.studyType }}, {{ school.area }} ({{ school.startDate | date: '%Y' }} – {{ school.endDate | date: '%Y' }})
{%- endfor %}

## {{ s.cv.languages }}
{% for language in resume.languages %}
- {{ language.language }}: {{ language.fluency }}
{%- endfor %}

## {{ s.search.posts }}
{% for post in site.posts %}
{%- if post.sitemap == false or post.redirect %}{% continue %}{% endif %}
{%- comment %} The post as text: headings and list items keep a mark, the rest of the HTML is dropped. {% endcomment %}
{%- assign body = post.content
  | replace: '<h2', '## <h2'
  | replace: '<h3', '### <h3'
  | replace: '<h4', '#### <h4'
  | replace: '<li', '- <li'
  | replace: '</td>', ' | </td>'
  | replace: '</th>', ' | </th>'
  | strip_html
  | replace: '&lt;', '<'
  | replace: '&gt;', '>'
  | replace: '&quot;', '"'
  | replace: '&#39;', "'"
  | replace: '&amp;', '&'
  | strip
-%}

---

# {{ post.title }}

{{ lang_root }}{{ post.url }} · {{ post.date | date: '%Y-%m-%d' }}{% if post.last_updated %} · {{ s.post.last_updated }} {{ post.last_updated | date: '%Y-%m-%d' }}{% endif %}

{{ post.description }}

{{ body }}
{% endfor %}
